import rational = "./rational.qui"
import intersections = "./intersections.qui"
import rings = "./rings.qui"

class Crossing(rational.Point point, int ring_a, int edge_a, int ring_b, int edge_b, rational.Fraction position_a, rational.Fraction position_b)
class Node(rational.Point point, int crossing_id, bool entering)
class Location(ring_a := 0, index_a := 0, ring_b := 0, index_b := 0)
class Ordered(rational.Point point, bool entering)

class Graph(Node[][][] nodes, Location[] locations, Ordered[] ordered, int[] crossing_order, int inside_a, int inside_b)
    rational.Point[][][] result(string kind)
        inverted := [false, false]
        if kind == "UNION"
            inverted = [true, true]
        elif kind == "DIFFERENCE"
            inverted = [true, false]
        visited := array(#locations, fill = false)
        rational.Point[][] output_rings := []
        for start_id := crossing_order[]
            if visited[start_id]
                continue
            side := 0
            current_id := start_id
            rational.Point[] points := []
            while true
                location := locations[current_id]
                ring_index := if side == 0 then location.ring_a else location.ring_b
                node_index := if side == 0 then location.index_a else location.index_b
                sequence := nodes[side][ring_index]
                current_node := sequence[node_index]
                visited[current_id] = true
                points = points.append(current_node.point)
                forward := current_node.entering != inverted[side]
                next_index := node_index
                while true
                    next_index = if forward then (next_index + 1) % int(#sequence) else (next_index + int(#sequence) - 1) % int(#sequence)
                    if sequence[next_index].crossing_id >= 0
                        break
                    points = points.append(sequence[next_index].point)
                found_id := sequence[next_index].crossing_id
                if found_id == start_id
                    break
                current_id = found_id
                side = 1 - side
            output_rings = output_rings.append(points)
        for: side_index < 2
            rational.Point[][] other_rings := []
            for other_nodes := nodes[1 - side_index][]
                rational.Point[] other_points := []
                for other_node := other_nodes[]
                    other_points = other_points.append(other_node.point)
                other_rings = other_rings.append(other_points)
            for sequence_nodes := nodes[side_index][]
                has_crossing := false
                rational.Point[] ring_points := []
                for listed_node := sequence_nodes[]
                    has_crossing = has_crossing or listed_node.crossing_id >= 0
                    ring_points = ring_points.append(listed_node.point)
                if not has_crossing and rings.interior(ring_points[0], other_rings) != inverted[side_index]
                    output_rings = output_rings.append(ring_points)
        return rings.assemble(output_rings)

Graph build(const rational.Point[][] first, const rational.Point[][] second)
    inside_a := 0
    inside_b := 0
    for first_ring := first[]
        if rings.interior(first_ring[0], second)
            inside_a += 1
    for second_ring := second[]
        if rings.interior(second_ring[0], first)
            inside_b += 1
    Crossing[] crossings := []
    for: ring_a < int(#first)
        for: edge_a < int(#first[ring_a])
            for: ring_b < int(#second)
                for: edge_b < int(#second[ring_b])
                    found := intersections.crossing(first[ring_a][edge_a], first[ring_a][(edge_a + 1) % int(#first[ring_a])], second[ring_b][edge_b], second[ring_b][(edge_b + 1) % int(#second[ring_b])])
                    match found
                        intersections.Crossing value
                            crossings = crossings.append(Crossing(value.point, ring_a, edge_a, ring_b, edge_b, value.position_a, value.position_b))
                        none
                            continue
    locations := array(#crossings, fill = Location())
    Node[][][] nodes := [[], []]
    Ordered[] ordered := []
    int[] crossing_order := []
    for: side < 2
        primary := if side == 0 then first else second
        secondary := if side == 0 then second else first
        for: ring_index < int(#primary)
            ring := primary[ring_index]
            Node[] sequence := []
            in_other := rings.interior(ring[0], secondary)
            for: edge_index < int(#ring)
                sequence = sequence.append(Node(ring[edge_index], -1, false))
                int[] on_edge := []
                for: crossing_index < int(#crossings)
                    candidate := crossings[crossing_index]
                    belongs := if side == 0 then candidate.ring_a == ring_index and candidate.edge_a == edge_index else candidate.ring_b == ring_index and candidate.edge_b == edge_index
                    if belongs
                        on_edge = on_edge.append(crossing_index)
                for: position < int(#on_edge)
                    current := position
                    while current > 0
                        candidate_crossing := crossings[on_edge[current]]
                        previous_crossing := crossings[on_edge[current - 1]]
                        earlier := if side == 0 then candidate_crossing.position_a.less(previous_crossing.position_a) else candidate_crossing.position_b.less(previous_crossing.position_b)
                        if not earlier
                            break
                        saved := on_edge[current]
                        on_edge[current] = on_edge[current - 1]
                        on_edge[current - 1] = saved
                        current -= 1
                for id := on_edge[]
                    if side == 0
                        locations[id].ring_a = ring_index
                        locations[id].index_a = int(#sequence)
                        crossing_order = crossing_order.append(id)
                        ordered = ordered.append(Ordered(crossings[id].point, not in_other))
                    else
                        locations[id].ring_b = ring_index
                        locations[id].index_b = int(#sequence)
                    sequence = sequence.append(Node(crossings[id].point, id, not in_other))
                    in_other = not in_other
            nodes[side] = nodes[side].append(sequence)
    return Graph(nodes, locations, ordered, crossing_order, inside_a, inside_b)

import rational = "./rational.qui"

bool on(rational.Point first, rational.Point second, rational.Point point)
    left := if rational.x_less(first, second) then first else second
    right := if rational.x_less(first, second) then second else first
    low := if rational.y_less(first, second) then first else second
    high := if rational.y_less(first, second) then second else first
    return rational.cross(first, second, point) == 0 and not rational.x_less(point, left) and not rational.x_less(right, point) and not rational.y_less(point, low) and not rational.y_less(high, point)

bool opposite(int first, int second)
    return (first < 0 and second > 0) or (first > 0 and second < 0)

bool touch(rational.Point first, rational.Point second, rational.Point third, rational.Point fourth)
    proper_crossing := opposite(rational.cross(first, second, third), rational.cross(first, second, fourth)) and opposite(rational.cross(third, fourth, first), rational.cross(third, fourth, second))
    return proper_crossing or on(first, second, third) or on(first, second, fourth) or on(third, fourth, first) or on(third, fourth, second)

bool overlap(rational.Point first, rational.Point second, rational.Point third, rational.Point fourth)
    if rational.cross(first, second, third) != 0 or rational.cross(first, second, fourth) != 0
        return false
    horizontal := first.x * second.denominator != second.x * first.denominator
    first_value := rational.Fraction(if horizontal then first.x else first.y, first.denominator)
    second_value := rational.Fraction(if horizontal then second.x else second.y, second.denominator)
    third_value := rational.Fraction(if horizontal then third.x else third.y, third.denominator)
    fourth_value := rational.Fraction(if horizontal then fourth.x else fourth.y, fourth.denominator)
    lower_a := if first_value.less(second_value) then first_value else second_value
    upper_a := if first_value.less(second_value) then second_value else first_value
    lower_b := if third_value.less(fourth_value) then third_value else fourth_value
    upper_b := if third_value.less(fourth_value) then fourth_value else third_value
    lower := if lower_a.less(lower_b) then lower_b else lower_a
    upper := if upper_a.less(upper_b) then upper_a else upper_b
    return lower.less(upper)

class Line(int horizontal, int vertical, int constant)

Line line(rational.Point first, rational.Point second)
    horizontal := first.y * second.denominator - first.denominator * second.y
    vertical := first.denominator * second.x - first.x * second.denominator
    constant := first.x * second.y - first.y * second.x
    divisor := rational.gcd(rational.gcd(horizontal, vertical), constant)
    return Line(horizontal / divisor, vertical / divisor, constant / divisor)

rational.Point line_intersection(rational.Point first, rational.Point second, rational.Point third, rational.Point fourth)
    left := line(first, second)
    right := line(third, fourth)
    return rational.Point(left.vertical * right.constant - left.constant * right.vertical, left.constant * right.horizontal - left.horizontal * right.constant, left.horizontal * right.vertical - left.vertical * right.horizontal)

class Crossing(rational.Point point, rational.Fraction position_a, rational.Fraction position_b)

Crossing | none crossing(rational.Point first, rational.Point second, rational.Point third, rational.Point fourth)
    horizontal_a := second.x - first.x
    vertical_a := second.y - first.y
    horizontal_b := fourth.x - third.x
    vertical_b := fourth.y - third.y
    denominator := horizontal_a * vertical_b - vertical_a * horizontal_b
    if denominator == 0
        return none
    horizontal_gap := third.x - first.x
    vertical_gap := third.y - first.y
    numerator_a := horizontal_gap * vertical_b - vertical_gap * horizontal_b
    numerator_b := horizontal_gap * vertical_a - vertical_gap * horizontal_a
    if denominator < 0
        denominator = -denominator
        numerator_a = -numerator_a
        numerator_b = -numerator_b
    if numerator_a <= 0 or numerator_a >= denominator or numerator_b <= 0 or numerator_b >= denominator
        return none
    point := rational.Point(first.x * denominator + numerator_a * horizontal_a, first.y * denominator + numerator_a * vertical_a, denominator)
    return Crossing(point, rational.Fraction(numerator_a, denominator), rational.Fraction(numerator_b, denominator))

string segment(rational.Point first, rational.Point second)
    return "{first.text()}-{second.text()}"

import rational = "./rational.qui"
import intersections = "./intersections.qui"
import rings = "./rings.qui"
import gh = "./greiner_hormann.qui"
import render = "./render.qui"

class Polygon(rational.Point[][] input_rings, rational.Point[][] canonical)
class Target(rational.Point[][][] region, binary := false, rational.Point[][] operand_a := [], rational.Point[][] operand_b := [])
class Definition(string name, Polygon polygon)
class SourceLine(int number, string text)

bool digits(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for: position < int(#text)
        if text[position].codepoints()[0] < 48 or text[position].codepoints()[0] > 57
            return false
    return true

int | none integer_word(string text)
    body := text
    if body.starts_with("-")
        body = body[1:<int(#body)]
    if #body > 9 or not digits(body)
        return none
    value := int(text)
    return value

int integer_value(string text)
    value := int(text)
    return value

bool valid_name(string text)
    if #text == 0 or #text > 16
        return false
    for: index < int(#text)
        character := text[index]
        if not ((97 <= character.codepoints()[0] <= 122) or (48 <= character.codepoints()[0] <= 57) or character == "_")
            return false
    return true

string | none validate(const rational.Point[][] input_rings)
    for: ring_index < int(#input_rings)
        ring := input_rings[ring_index]
        count := int(#ring)
        number := ring_index + 1
        if count < 3
            return "too_few_vertices ring {number}"
        for point := ring[]
            if point.x < 0 or point.y < 0 or point.x > 1000 * point.denominator or point.y > 1000 * point.denominator
                return "out_of_range ring {number} {point.text()}"
        rational.Point[] seen := []
        for point := ring[]
            if rational.has(seen, point)
                return "duplicate_vertex ring {number} {point.text()}"
            seen = seen.append(point)
        for: index < count
            if rational.cross(ring[(index + count - 1) % count], ring[index], ring[(index + 1) % count]) == 0
                return "collinear ring {number} {ring[index].text()}"
        for: first_edge < count
            for: first_edge + 1 <= second_edge < count
                if second_edge == first_edge + 1 or (first_edge == 0 and second_edge == count - 1)
                    continue
                first_start := ring[first_edge]
                first_end := ring[(first_edge + 1) % count]
                second_start := ring[second_edge]
                second_end := ring[(second_edge + 1) % count]
                if intersections.touch(first_start, first_end, second_start, second_end)
                    return "self_intersection ring {number} {intersections.segment(first_start, first_end)} {intersections.segment(second_start, second_end)}"
    for: first_ring < int(#input_rings)
        for: first_ring + 1 <= second_ring < int(#input_rings)
            first := input_rings[first_ring]
            second := input_rings[second_ring]
            for: first_edge < int(#first)
                for: second_edge < int(#second)
                    first_start := first[first_edge]
                    first_end := first[(first_edge + 1) % int(#first)]
                    second_start := second[second_edge]
                    second_end := second[(second_edge + 1) % int(#second)]
                    if intersections.touch(first_start, first_end, second_start, second_end)
                        return "rings_touch rings {first_ring + 1} {second_ring + 1} {intersections.segment(first_start, first_end)} {intersections.segment(second_start, second_end)}"
    for: 1 <= hole < int(#input_rings)
        if not rings.inside(input_rings[hole][0], input_rings[0])
            return "hole_outside ring {hole + 1} {input_rings[hole][0].text()}"
    for: 1 <= first_hole < int(#input_rings)
        for: first_hole + 1 <= second_hole < int(#input_rings)
            if rings.inside(input_rings[second_hole][0], input_rings[first_hole])
                return "hole_in_hole rings {first_hole + 1} {second_hole + 1} {input_rings[second_hole][0].text()}"
            if rings.inside(input_rings[first_hole][0], input_rings[second_hole])
                return "hole_in_hole rings {first_hole + 1} {second_hole + 1} {input_rings[first_hole][0].text()}"
    return none

rational.Point[][] | error parse_block(const SourceLine[] content, int end_line)
    rational.Point[][] input_rings := []
    index := 0
    while index < int(#content)
        header := content[index]
        words := header.text.split(" ")
        if #words != 2
            return error("format line {header.number}")
        appropriate := (words[0] == "OUTER" and #input_rings == 0) or (words[0] == "HOLE" and #input_rings > 0)
        if not appropriate or #words[1] > 9 or not digits(words[1])
            return error("format line {header.number}")
        vertex_count := integer_value(words[1])
        if vertex_count <= 0
            return error("format line {header.number}")
        index += 1
        rational.Point[] ring := []
        for: vertex_index < vertex_count
            if index == int(#content)
                return error("format line {end_line}")
            vertex_line := content[index]
            coordinates := vertex_line.text.split(" ")
            if #coordinates != 2
                return error("format line {vertex_line.number}")
            int horizontal
            int vertical
            match integer_word(coordinates[0])
                int parsed_x
                    horizontal = parsed_x
                none
                    return error("format line {vertex_line.number}")
            match integer_word(coordinates[1])
                int parsed_y
                    vertical = parsed_y
                none
                    return error("format line {vertex_line.number}")
            ring = ring.append(rational.Point(horizontal, vertical))
            index += 1
        input_rings = input_rings.append(ring)
    if #input_rings == 0
        return error("format line {end_line}")
    return input_rings

Polygon | error checked_polygon(const rational.Point[][] input_rings)
    match validate(input_rings)
        string reason
            return error(reason)
        none
            return Polygon(input_rings, rings.canonical(input_rings))

Polygon | error block_polygon(const SourceLine[] content, int end_line)
    input_rings := try parse_block(content, end_line)
    return checked_polygon(input_rings)

class Polygons()
    used := distinct<string>()
    valid := map<string, Polygon>()
    string[] rejected := []
    blocks := 0
    valid_blocks := 0

Polygons read_polygons()
    string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/polygons.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    collection := Polygons()
    index := 0
    while index < int(#lines)
        if lines[index] == "" or lines[index].starts_with("#")
            index += 1
            continue
        start_words := lines[index].split(" ")
        name := start_words[1]
        start_line := index + 1
        index += 1
        SourceLine[] content := []
        while lines[index] != "END"
            if lines[index] != "" and not lines[index].starts_with("#")
                content = content.append(SourceLine(index + 1, lines[index]))
            index += 1
        end_line := index + 1
        index += 1
        collection.blocks += 1
        if collection.used.has(name)
            collection.rejected = collection.rejected.append("polygon {name} duplicate_name line {start_line}")
            continue
        .collection.used.add(name)
        match block_polygon(content, end_line)
            Polygon polygon
                .collection.valid.set(name, polygon)
                collection.valid_blocks += 1
            error problem
                collection.rejected = collection.rejected.append("polygon {name} {problem.message}")
    return collection

Polygon | error resolve_polygon(const Polygons collection, string name)
    if not collection.used.has(name)
        return error("unknown_polygon {name}")
    match collection.valid.get(name)
        Polygon polygon
            return polygon
        none
            return error("invalid_polygon {name}")

Target | error resolve_target(string text, const Polygons collection, const map<int, Target> results)
    if text.starts_with("@")
        suffix := text[1:<int(#text)]
        if #suffix > 9 or not digits(suffix)
            return error("bad_target {text}")
        number := integer_value(suffix)
        match results.get(number)
            Target found
                return found
            none
                return error("bad_target {text}")
    polygon := try resolve_polygon(collection, text)
    return Target([polygon.canonical])

string | none general(const rational.Point[][] first, const rational.Point[][] second, string first_name, string second_name)
    for first_ring := first[]
        for point := first_ring[]
            for second_ring := second[]
                if rational.has(second_ring, point)
                    return "shared_vertex {point.text()}"
    for first_ring := first[]
        for: first_edge < int(#first_ring)
            for second_ring := second[]
                for: second_edge < int(#second_ring)
                    first_start := first_ring[first_edge]
                    first_end := first_ring[(first_edge + 1) % int(#first_ring)]
                    second_start := second_ring[second_edge]
                    second_end := second_ring[(second_edge + 1) % int(#second_ring)]
                    if intersections.overlap(first_start, first_end, second_start, second_end)
                        return "overlapping_edges {intersections.segment(first_start, first_end)} {intersections.segment(second_start, second_end)}"
    for: side < 2
        vertices := if side == 0 then first else second
        edges := if side == 0 then second else first
        vertex_name := if side == 0 then first_name else second_name
        edge_name := if side == 0 then second_name else first_name
        for vertex_ring := vertices[]
            for point := vertex_ring[]
                for edge_ring := edges[]
                    for: edge_index < int(#edge_ring)
                        edge_start := edge_ring[edge_index]
                        edge_end := edge_ring[(edge_index + 1) % int(#edge_ring)]
                        if intersections.on(edge_start, edge_end, point)
                            return "vertex_on_edge {vertex_name} {point.text()} {edge_name} {intersections.segment(edge_start, edge_end)}"
    return none

bool convex(const rational.Point[][] input_rings)
    if #input_rings != 1
        return false
    ring := input_rings[0]
    count := int(#ring)
    for: index < count
        if rational.cross(ring[(index + count - 1) % count], ring[index], ring[(index + 1) % count]) <= 0
            return false
    return true

rational.Point[][] clip(const rational.Point[][] input_rings, const rational.Point[] window)
    rational.Point[][] result := []
    for source_ring := input_rings[]
        points := source_ring
        for: edge < int(#window)
            first := window[edge]
            second := window[(edge + 1) % int(#window)]
            rational.Point[] next_points := []
            for: index < int(#points)
                previous := points[(index + int(#points) - 1) % int(#points)]
                current := points[index]
                previous_inside := rational.cross(first, second, previous) > 0
                current_inside := rational.cross(first, second, current) > 0
                if previous_inside != current_inside
                    next_points = next_points.append(intersections.line_intersection(previous, current, first, second))
                if current_inside
                    next_points = next_points.append(current)
            points = next_points
        rational.Point[] clean := []
        for: index < int(#points)
            if points[index] != points[(index + int(#points) - 1) % int(#points)]
                clean = clean.append(points[index])
        if #clean >= 3
            result = result.append(clean)
    return result

bool cyclic(const rational.Point[] first, const rational.Point[] second)
    if #first != #second
        return false
    for: offset < int(#second)
        equal := true
        for: index < int(#first)
            if first[index] != second[(index + offset) % int(#second)]
                equal = false
                break
        if equal
            return true
    return false

string locate(const rational.Point[][][] region, rational.Point point)
    for: polygon_index < int(#region)
        polygon := region[polygon_index]
        for: ring_index < int(#polygon)
            if rings.boundary(point, polygon[ring_index])
                if ring_index == 0
                    return "boundary outer {polygon_index + 1}"
                return "boundary hole {polygon_index + 1} {ring_index}"
    for: polygon_index < int(#region)
        polygon := region[polygon_index]
        if not rings.inside(point, polygon[0])
            continue
        hole := false
        for: 1 <= ring_index < int(#polygon)
            hole = hole or rings.inside(point, polygon[ring_index])
        if not hole
            return "inside polygon {polygon_index + 1}"
    return "outside"

string operand_location(rational.Point point, const rational.Point[][] input_rings)
    for ring := input_rings[]
        if rings.boundary(point, ring)
            return "boundary"
    return if rings.interior(point, input_rings) then "inside" else "outside"

rational.Point[] hull_half(const rational.Point[] points)
    rational.Point[] result := []
    for point := points[]
        while #result >= 2
            count := int(#result)
            if rational.cross(result[count - 2], result[count - 1], point) > 0
                break
            result = result[0:<count - 1]
        result = result.append(point)
    return result[0:<int(#result) - 1]

rational.Point[] convex_hull(const rational.Point[] ring)
    rational.Point[] ordered := rational.sorted_points(ring, by_x = true)
    backward := ordered[::-1]
    return hull_half(ordered).concat(hull_half(backward))

int twice_area(const rational.Point[] ring)
    total := 0
    for: index < int(#ring)
        first := ring[index]
        second := ring[(index + 1) % int(#ring)]
        total += first.x * second.y - second.x * first.y
    return total

bool has_vertex(const rational.Point[][] input_rings, rational.Point point)
    for ring := input_rings[]
        if rational.has(ring, point)
            return true
    return false

class Values(string[] lines, int ring_count, int hole_count, int vertex_count, real64 area)

Values result_values(const rational.Point[][][] region, const rational.Point[][] operand_a, const rational.Point[][] operand_b)
    ring_count := 0
    vertex_count := 0
    for polygon := region[]
        ring_count += int(#polygon)
        for ring := polygon[]
            vertex_count += int(#ring)
    hole_count := ring_count - int(#region)
    area := rings.total_area(region)
    lines := ["polygons {#region} rings {ring_count} holes {hole_count} vertices {vertex_count} area {rational.real_text(area)}"]
    real64 centroid_x := 0.0
    real64 centroid_y := 0.0
    real64 perimeter := 0.0
    origins := [0, 0, 0]
    rational.Point[] points := []
    for: polygon_index < int(#region)
        polygon := region[polygon_index]
        for: ring_index < int(#polygon)
            ring := polygon[ring_index]
            label := if ring_index == 0 then "outer {polygon_index + 1}" else "hole {polygon_index + 1} {ring_index}"
            string[] printed_points := []
            for point := ring[]
                printed_points = printed_points.append(point.text())
            lines = lines.append("{label} {#ring} {rational.real_text(rings.area(ring))} {printed_points.join(" ")}")
            perimeter += rings.perimeter(ring)
            for: index < int(#ring)
                first := ring[index]
                second := ring[(index + 1) % int(#ring)]
                horizontal := first.real_x()
                vertical := first.real_y()
                next_horizontal := second.real_x()
                next_vertical := second.real_y()
                product := horizontal * next_vertical - next_horizontal * vertical
                centroid_x += (horizontal + next_horizontal) * product
                centroid_y += (vertical + next_vertical) * product
                if has_vertex(operand_a, first)
                    origins[0] += 1
                elif has_vertex(operand_b, first)
                    origins[1] += 1
                else
                    origins[2] += 1
                points = points.append(first)
    if #points == 0
        lines = lines.concat(["bbox none", "centroid none"])
    else
        minimum_x := points[0]
        minimum_y := points[0]
        maximum_x := points[0]
        maximum_y := points[0]
        for point := points[]
            if rational.x_less(point, minimum_x)
                minimum_x = point
            if rational.y_less(point, minimum_y)
                minimum_y = point
            if rational.x_less(maximum_x, point)
                maximum_x = point
            if rational.y_less(maximum_y, point)
                maximum_y = point
        low := rational.Point(minimum_x.x * minimum_y.denominator, minimum_y.y * minimum_x.denominator, minimum_x.denominator * minimum_y.denominator)
        high := rational.Point(maximum_x.x * maximum_y.denominator, maximum_y.y * maximum_x.denominator, maximum_x.denominator * maximum_y.denominator)
        lines = lines.append("bbox {low.text()} {high.text()}")
        center_x := centroid_x / (6.0 * area)
        center_y := centroid_y / (6.0 * area)
        lines = lines.append("centroid ({rational.real_text(center_x)},{rational.real_text(center_y)})")
    lines = lines.concat(["perimeter {rational.real_text(perimeter)}", "origins a {origins[0]} b {origins[1]} crossing {origins[2]}"])
    return Values(lines, ring_count, hole_count, vertex_count, area)

string[] properties(Polygon polygon, real64 area)
    string[] orientations := []
    for input_ring := polygon.input_rings[]
        orientations = orientations.append(if twice_area(input_ring) > 0 then "ccw" else "cw")
    reflex := 0
    for ring := polygon.canonical[]
        count := int(#ring)
        for: index < count
            if rational.cross(ring[(index + count - 1) % count], ring[index], ring[(index + 1) % count]) < 0
                reflex += 1
    hull := convex_hull(polygon.canonical[0])
    hull_area := real64(twice_area(hull)) / 2.0
    solidity := area / hull_area
    return ["input {orientations.join(" ")}", "reflex {reflex}", "hull {#hull} {rational.real_text(hull_area)} solidity {rational.real_text(solidity, 6)}"]

string[] operation_kinds()
    return ["UNION", "INTERSECTION", "DIFFERENCE", "XOR", "CLIP", "AREA", "MOVE", "ROTATE", "MIRROR", "SNAP", "LOCATE", "RENDER"]

bool in_range(string text, int low, int high)
    match integer_word(text)
        int value
            return low <= value <= high
        none
            return false

bool arguments(const string[] words)
    kind := words[0]
    expected := 3
    if kind == "AREA"
        expected = 2
    elif kind == "LOCATE"
        expected = 4
    elif kind == "MOVE" or kind == "MIRROR"
        expected = 5
    elif kind == "ROTATE"
        expected = 6
    elif kind == "RENDER"
        expected = 8
    if int(#words) != expected
        return false
    if kind == "LOCATE"
        return in_range(words[2], 0, 1000) and in_range(words[3], 0, 1000)
    if kind == "RENDER"
        if not (in_range(words[2], 0, 1000) and in_range(words[3], 0, 1000) and in_range(words[4], 1, 100) and in_range(words[5], 1, 100) and in_range(words[6], 1, 100) and in_range(words[7], 1, 60))
            return false
        return integer_value(words[2]) + integer_value(words[4]) * integer_value(words[6]) <= 1000 and integer_value(words[3]) + integer_value(words[5]) * integer_value(words[7]) <= 1000
    if kind == "MOVE"
        return in_range(words[2], -1000, 1000) and in_range(words[3], -1000, 1000) and valid_name(words[4])
    if kind == "ROTATE"
        return in_range(words[2], 0, 1000) and in_range(words[3], 0, 1000) and in_range(words[4], 1, 3) and valid_name(words[5])
    if kind == "MIRROR"
        return (words[2] == "x" or words[2] == "y") and in_range(words[3], 0, 1000) and valid_name(words[4])
    if kind == "SNAP"
        return valid_name(words[2])
    return true

void | error require_general(const rational.Point[][] first, const rational.Point[][] second, string first_name, string second_name)
    match general(first, second, first_name, second_name)
        string reason
            return error(reason)
        none
            return

Polygon | error transform_polygon(string kind, const string[] words, Polygon original, Target resolved, string new_name)
    rational.Point[][] input_rings := []
    if kind == "SNAP"
        for target_ring := resolved.region[0][]
            rational.Point[] snapped_ring := []
            for target_point := target_ring[]
                snapped_ring = snapped_ring.append(target_point.snapped())
            input_rings = input_rings.append(snapped_ring)
        match validate(input_rings)
            string reason
                return error("invalid_result {reason}")
            none
                return Polygon(input_rings, rings.canonical(input_rings))
    for original_ring := original.input_rings[]
        rational.Point[] moved_ring := []
        for original_point := original_ring[]
            horizontal := original_point.x
            vertical := original_point.y
            if kind == "MOVE"
                horizontal += integer_value(words[2])
                vertical += integer_value(words[3])
            elif kind == "ROTATE"
                center_x := integer_value(words[2])
                center_y := integer_value(words[3])
                turns := integer_value(words[4])
                for: turn < turns
                    next_x := center_x - (vertical - center_y)
                    next_y := center_y + (horizontal - center_x)
                    horizontal = next_x
                    vertical = next_y
            else
                reflection_line := integer_value(words[3])
                if words[2] == "x"
                    horizontal = 2 * reflection_line - horizontal
                else
                    vertical = 2 * reflection_line - vertical
            moved_ring = moved_ring.append(rational.Point(horizontal, vertical))
        input_rings = input_rings.append(moved_ring)
    for transformed_ring := input_rings[]
        for transformed_point := transformed_ring[]
            if transformed_point.x < 0 or transformed_point.y < 0 or transformed_point.x > 1000 or transformed_point.y > 1000
                return error("out_of_range {new_name}")
    return Polygon(input_rings, rings.canonical(input_rings))

class Operation(string[] lines)
    string[] area_lines := []
    string[] drawing := []
    Target | none target := none
    Definition | none definition := none
    crossings := 0

Operation | error operation(int number, string text, const Polygons collection, const map<int, Target> results)
    words := text.split(" ")
    kind := words[0]
    kinds := operation_kinds()
    if not rational.has(kinds, kind)
        return error("unknown_operation {kind}")
    if not arguments(words)
        return error("bad_arguments")
    binary := rational.has(kinds[0:<5], kind)
    defining := rational.has(["MOVE", "ROTATE", "MIRROR", "SNAP"], kind)
    primary := Polygon([], [])
    secondary := Polygon([], [])
    resolved := Target([])
    if binary or rational.has(["AREA", "MOVE", "ROTATE", "MIRROR"], kind)
        primary = try resolve_polygon(collection, words[1])
    if binary
        secondary = try resolve_polygon(collection, words[2])
    if rational.has(["LOCATE", "RENDER", "SNAP"], kind)
        resolved = try resolve_target(words[1], collection, results)
    new_name := ""
    if defining
        new_name = words[-1]
        if collection.used.has(new_name)
            return error("duplicate_name {new_name}")
    if kind == "SNAP" and #resolved.region != 1
        return error("not_single {words[1]}")
    if kind == "CLIP" and not convex(secondary.canonical)
        return error("not_convex {words[2]}")
    if binary
        try require_general(primary.canonical, secondary.canonical, words[1], words[2])
    result := Operation(["op {number} {text}"])
    if kind == "LOCATE"
        point := rational.Point(integer_value(words[2]), integer_value(words[3]))
        result.lines = result.lines.append("location {locate(resolved.region, point)}")
        if resolved.binary
            result.lines = result.lines.append("operands a {operand_location(point, resolved.operand_a)} b {operand_location(point, resolved.operand_b)}")
        return result
    if kind == "RENDER"
        int[] settings := []
        for: 2 <= index < int(#words)
            settings = settings.append(integer_value(words[index]))
        rendered := render.draw(resolved.region, resolved.operand_a, resolved.operand_b, resolved.binary, settings)
        counts := rendered.counts
        result.drawing = ["render {number} {words[1]} cols {settings[4]} rows {settings[5]} result {counts[0]} a {counts[1]} b {counts[2]} both {counts[3]}"].concat(rendered.lines)
        result.lines = []
        return result
    polygon := primary
    if defining
        polygon = try transform_polygon(kind, words, primary, resolved, new_name)
        result.definition = Definition(new_name, polygon)
    rational.Point[][][] region := []
    if binary
        first_rings := primary.canonical
        second_rings := secondary.canonical
        graph := gh.build(first_rings, second_rings)
        relation := "overlap"
        if #graph.ordered == 0
            if graph.inside_a == int(#first_rings) and graph.inside_b == 0
                relation = "within"
            elif graph.inside_b == int(#second_rings) and graph.inside_a == 0
                relation = "contains"
            elif graph.inside_a == 0 and graph.inside_b == 0
                relation = "disjoint"
        union_region := graph.result("UNION")
        intersection := graph.result("INTERSECTION")
        iou := rings.total_area(intersection) / rings.total_area(union_region)
        result.crossings = int(#graph.ordered)
        result.lines = result.lines.concat(["relation {relation} iou {rational.real_text(iou, 6)}", "crossings {result.crossings}"])
        for crossing := graph.ordered[]
            direction := if crossing.entering then "in" else "out"
            result.lines = result.lines.append("crossing {crossing.point.text()} {direction}")
        if kind == "UNION"
            region = union_region
        elif kind == "INTERSECTION" or kind == "CLIP"
            region = intersection
        elif kind == "DIFFERENCE"
            region = graph.result("DIFFERENCE")
        else
            reversed_graph := gh.build(second_rings, first_rings)
            region = rings.sorted_polygons(graph.result("DIFFERENCE").concat(reversed_graph.result("DIFFERENCE")))
        result.target = Target(region, true, first_rings, second_rings)
    else
        region = [polygon.canonical]
        result.target = Target(region)
    origin_a := if binary then primary.canonical else polygon.canonical
    rational.Point[][] origin_b := if binary then secondary.canonical else []
    computed := result_values(region, origin_a, origin_b)
    result.lines = result.lines.concat(computed.lines)
    joined_words := words.join(":")
    result.area_lines = ["{number}:{joined_words},{computed.ring_count},{computed.hole_count},{computed.vertex_count},{rational.real_text(computed.area)}"]
    if not binary
        result.lines = result.lines.concat(properties(polygon, computed.area))
    if kind == "CLIP"
        clipped := clip(origin_a, secondary.canonical[0])
        result_rings := rings.flatten(region)
        equal := #clipped == #result_rings
        for result_ring := result_rings[]
            found := false
            for clipped_ring := clipped[]
                if cyclic(result_ring, clipped_ring)
                    found = true
                    break
            equal = equal and found
        vertex_count := 0
        for clipped_ring := clipped[]
            vertex_count += int(#clipped_ring)
        verdict := if equal then "match" else "mismatch"
        result.lines = result.lines.append("crosscheck {verdict} rings {#clipped} vertices {vertex_count}")
    return result

void record_target(map<int, Target> &targets, int number, Target | none value)
    match value
        Target saved
            .targets.set(number, saved)
        none
            return

int record_definition(Polygons &collection, Definition | none value)
    match value
        Definition added
            .collection.used.add(added.name)
            .collection.valid.set(added.name, added.polygon)
            return 1
        none
            return 0

void write(string name, const string[] lines)
    bool present := file.is_directory("output")
    if not present
        file.mkdir("output")
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(text)

void run_program()
    collection := read_polygons()
    map<int, Target> targets
    rejections := collection.rejected
    string[] results := []
    areas := ["operation,rings,holes,vertices,area"]
    string[] drawing := []
    total := 0
    succeeded := 0
    defined := 0
    crossing_count := 0
    kinds := operation_kinds()
    int[][] counts := array(#kinds, fill = [0, 0])
    string operation_text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/operations.txt"))
    operation_lines := operation_text.split(NL)
    for line := operation_lines[]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("#")
            continue
        total += 1
        words := line.split(" ")
        kind := words[0]
        kind_index := -1
        for: index < int(#kinds)
            if kinds[index] == kind
                kind_index = index
                break
        if kind_index >= 0
            counts[kind_index][0] += 1
        match operation(total, line, collection, targets)
            Operation accepted
                succeeded += 1
                counts[kind_index][1] += 1
                crossing_count += accepted.crossings
                results = results.concat(accepted.lines)
                areas = areas.concat(accepted.area_lines)
                drawing = drawing.concat(accepted.drawing)
                record_target(&targets, total, accepted.target)
                defined += record_definition(&collection, accepted.definition)
            error rejected
                rejections = rejections.append("op {total} {rejected.message}")
    results = results.concat(["summary polygons {collection.blocks} valid {collection.valid_blocks} invalid {collection.blocks - collection.valid_blocks} defined {defined}", "summary operations {total} succeeded {succeeded} rejected {total - succeeded}", "summary crossings {crossing_count}"])
    for: index < int(#kinds)
        results = results.append("kind {kinds[index]} {counts[index][0]} {counts[index][1]}")
    rejections = ["rejections {#rejections}"].concat(rejections)
    write("results.txt", results)
    write("areas.csv", areas)
    write("render.txt", drawing)
    write("rejections.txt", rejections)

if main
    run_program()

int gcd(int first, int second)
    left := if first < 0 then -first else first
    right := if second < 0 then -second else second
    while right != 0
        left, right = right, left % right
    return left

class Fraction(int numerator, denominator := 1)
    local divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    local sign := if denominator < 0 then -1 else 1
    numerator = numerator / divisor * sign
    denominator = denominator / divisor * sign

    bool less(Fraction other)
        return numerator * other.denominator < other.numerator * denominator

    string text()
        return if denominator == 1 then string(numerator) else "{numerator}/{denominator}"

int floor_divide(int numerator, int denominator)
    quotient := numerator / denominator
    return if numerator % denominator < 0 then quotient - 1 else quotient

class Point(int x, int y, denominator := 1)
    local divisor := gcd(gcd(x, y), denominator)
    local sign := if denominator < 0 then -1 else 1
    x = x / divisor * sign
    y = y / divisor * sign
    denominator = denominator / divisor * sign

    real64 real_x()
        return real64(x) / real64(denominator)

    real64 real_y()
        return real64(y) / real64(denominator)

    Point snapped()
        return Point(floor_divide(2 * x + denominator, 2 * denominator), floor_divide(2 * y + denominator, 2 * denominator))

    string text()
        horizontal := Fraction(x, denominator)
        vertical := Fraction(y, denominator)
        return "({horizontal.text()},{vertical.text()})"

bool x_less(Point first, Point second)
    return first.x * second.denominator < second.x * first.denominator

bool y_less(Point first, Point second)
    return first.y * second.denominator < second.y * first.denominator

bool less(Point first, Point second)
    if first.y * second.denominator == second.y * first.denominator
        return x_less(first, second)
    return y_less(first, second)

int cross(Point origin, Point first, Point second)
    return (first.x * second.y - first.y * second.x) * origin.denominator + (second.x * origin.y - second.y * origin.x) * first.denominator + (origin.x * first.y - origin.y * first.x) * second.denominator

string real_text(real64 value, digits := 3)
    if digits == 3
        return "{value:.3}"
    return "{value:.6}"

bool has<T>(const T[] values, T sought)
    for item := values[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

Point[] sorted_points(const Point[] values, by_x := false)
    result := values
    for: position < int(#result)
        current := position
        while current > 0
            candidate := result[current]
            previous := result[current - 1]
            precedes := less(candidate, previous)
            if by_x
                precedes = x_less(candidate, previous) or (not x_less(previous, candidate) and y_less(candidate, previous))
            if not precedes
                break
            result[current] = previous
            result[current - 1] = candidate
            current -= 1
    return result

import rational = "./rational.qui"
import rings = "./rings.qui"

class Drawing(string[] lines, int[] counts)

Drawing draw(const rational.Point[][][] region, const rational.Point[][] operand_a, const rational.Point[][] operand_b, bool binary, const int[] settings)
    origin_x := settings[0]
    origin_y := settings[1]
    width := settings[2]
    height := settings[3]
    columns := settings[4]
    row_count := settings[5]
    all_rings := rings.flatten(region)
    string[] lines := []
    counts := [0, 0, 0, 0]
    for: row < row_count
        text := ""
        for: column < columns
            center := rational.Point(2 * origin_x + (2 * column + 1) * width, 2 * origin_y + (2 * (row_count - 1 - row) + 1) * height, 2)
            if rings.interior(center, all_rings)
                counts[0] += 1
                text += "#"
            elif binary
                first := rings.interior(center, operand_a)
                second := rings.interior(center, operand_b)
                if first and second
                    counts[3] += 1
                    text += "+"
                elif first
                    counts[1] += 1
                    text += "a"
                elif second
                    counts[2] += 1
                    text += "b"
                else
                    text += "."
            else
                text += "."
        lines = lines.append(text)
    return Drawing(lines, counts)

import rational = "./rational.qui"
import intersections = "./intersections.qui"
import math

bool inside(rational.Point point, const rational.Point[] ring)
    odd := false
    count := int(#ring)
    for: index < count
        first := ring[index]
        second := ring[(index + 1) % count]
        if (first.y * point.denominator > point.y * first.denominator) != (second.y * point.denominator > point.y * second.denominator)
            low := if rational.y_less(first, second) then first else second
            high := if rational.y_less(first, second) then second else first
            if rational.cross(low, high, point) > 0
                odd = not odd
    return odd

bool interior(rational.Point point, const rational.Point[][] ring_list)
    odd := false
    for ring := ring_list[]
        if inside(point, ring)
            odd = not odd
    return odd

bool boundary(rational.Point point, const rational.Point[] ring)
    count := int(#ring)
    for: index < count
        if intersections.on(ring[index], ring[(index + 1) % count], point)
            return true
    return false

rational.Point[] rotate(const rational.Point[] ring)
    lowest := 0
    for: index < int(#ring)
        if rational.less(ring[index], ring[lowest])
            lowest = index
    rational.Point[] result := []
    for: offset < int(#ring)
        result = result.append(ring[(lowest + offset) % int(#ring)])
    return result

bool ccw(const rational.Point[] ring)
    return rational.cross(ring[-1], ring[0], ring[1]) > 0

rational.Point[] reverse(const rational.Point[] ring)
    result := [ring[0]]
    index := int(#ring) - 1
    while index > 0
        result = result.append(ring[index])
        index -= 1
    return result

rational.Point[][] sorted_rings(const rational.Point[][] source)
    result := source
    for: position < int(#result)
        current := position
        while current > 0 and rational.less(result[current][0], result[current - 1][0])
            saved := result[current]
            result[current] = result[current - 1]
            result[current - 1] = saved
            current -= 1
    return result

rational.Point[][] canonical(const rational.Point[][] input_rings)
    rational.Point[][] result := []
    rational.Point[][] holes := []
    for: index < int(#input_rings)
        ring := rotate(input_rings[index])
        if ccw(ring) != (index == 0)
            ring = reverse(ring)
        if index == 0
            result = result.append(ring)
        else
            holes = holes.append(ring)
    return result.concat(sorted_rings(holes))

rational.Point[][][] sorted_polygons(const rational.Point[][][] source)
    result := source
    for: position < int(#result)
        current := position
        while current > 0 and rational.less(result[current][0][0], result[current - 1][0][0])
            saved := result[current]
            result[current] = result[current - 1]
            result[current - 1] = saved
            current -= 1
    return result

rational.Point[][][] assemble(const rational.Point[][] source)
    rational.Point[][] normalized := []
    for ring := source[]
        normalized = normalized.append(rotate(ring))
    depths := array(#normalized, fill = 0)
    for: index < int(#normalized)
        for: other < int(#normalized)
            if index != other and inside(normalized[index][0], normalized[other])
                depths[index] += 1
        if ccw(normalized[index]) != (depths[index] % 2 == 0)
            normalized[index] = reverse(normalized[index])
    rational.Point[][][] result := []
    for: index < int(#normalized)
        if depths[index] % 2 == 0
            rational.Point[][] holes := []
            for: other < int(#normalized)
                if depths[other] == depths[index] + 1 and inside(normalized[other][0], normalized[index])
                    holes = holes.append(normalized[other])
            result = result.append([normalized[index]].concat(sorted_rings(holes)))
    return sorted_polygons(result)

real64 area(const rational.Point[] ring)
    real64 total := 0.0
    count := int(#ring)
    for: index < count
        first := ring[index]
        second := ring[(index + 1) % count]
        total += first.real_x() * second.real_y() - second.real_x() * first.real_y()
    return total / 2.0

real64 perimeter(const rational.Point[] ring)
    real64 total := 0.0
    count := int(#ring)
    for: index < count
        dx := ring[(index + 1) % count].real_x() - ring[index].real_x()
        dy := ring[(index + 1) % count].real_y() - ring[index].real_y()
        total += math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    return total

real64 total_area(const rational.Point[][][] region)
    real64 total := 0.0
    for polygon := region[]
        for ring := polygon[]
            total += area(ring)
    return total

rational.Point[][] flatten(const rational.Point[][][] region)
    rational.Point[][] result := []
    for polygon := region[]
        result = result.concat(polygon)
    return result
